# ECHO official Agent entry

BNB Chain 56. Official contracts are deployed. The owner activation and the first real Mint have been independently verified. Mint is open; always re-read on-chain switches before any transaction.

Read /agent.json, /network.json and /agent-guide.md. Check pinned runtime hashes, identity ownership, live Mint switches, exact quote value and explicit Mint/gas caps before preparing any signature.

Download the no-key, read-only CLI at /agent/echo-agent.zip. It cannot sign or broadcast. Real signatures use the official Binance Agentic Wallet skill.

The website displays real chain counters and events. Never treat a local estimate, command output, pending hash or a simulated fork result as a confirmed mainnet Mint.

Official website: https://echobsc.fun
Official Agent guide: https://echobsc.fun/agent-guide.md
